## workflow transition

Move an issue to a status, in Jira or on the forge

### Synopsis

Move an issue to the status named, matched whatever its case, by the move the
tracker offers from where the issue stands. The move is printed and confirmed
before it is made. A status the tracker does not offer is refused, naming those
it does, and so is a move that asks for fields, naming them: change its status
with t in the interface or Change status on the web, whose forms ask for them.
Either refusal exits 4. A blank status is refused before anything is asked.

```
workflow transition <issue> <status> [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  workflow transition PROJ-7 "In Review" --yes   # unattended
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help   help for transition
  -y, --yes    go ahead without the confirmation
```
